verdict.rationale: Security campaigns (github-docs-14) and Dependabot fixes (github-docs-6) imply remediation actions applied across many alerts/dependencies, and the official CLI/MCP server (github-probe-3, github-probe-4) provide scriptable interfaces that could be used for bulk automation, but there is no explicit documentation of an AI-native bulk-operation workflow (e.g., agent-driven mass issue/PR updates, bulk GraphQL mutations) in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit bulk API/CLI examples, documented multi-item agent actions, independent confirmation of scale performance.
